description: This file defines a PermissionsGuard class for managing access control in a NestJS application, handling permission checks based on OAuth tokens, API keys, and other authentication methods.

classes.name: PermissionsGuard
classes.description: A guard class implementing CanActivate to enforce permission-based access control using OAuth tokens and API keys.

methods.name: canActivate
methods.description: Main method to determine if a request has the necessary permissions based on tokens and OAuth client data.

methods.name: getOAuthClientByAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth client info associated with a given access token.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth client info by client ID.
